objective: Make a slice PR propose the next slice record, so the next slice is ready when the PR merges. The owner still confirms its scope, and files its ticket only after a yes.
why: Slice PRs now carry their own progress (#1714). The next slice still waits for a records PR. The owner chose to propose it in the slice PR on 2026-10-13. Naqid found the race and guard-branch risks, so the guards are part of this slice.

include: The orbit skill step that drafts the next slice from the plan order and the PR Reconciliation, with a Naqid challenge
Owner confirmation in the PR review; a basedOn-only change needs no new confirmation
One Next line in /approve-merge that names the proposed slice
/orbit handoff checks the slice record on the branch the PR merged into
Lint: at most one slice record per slice PR, on that PR plan revision and Reconciliation
Lint: fail when dev already has a slice record with no ticket for the same outcome
A withdrawn state in the plan notes for a no at handoff
No proposal when every outcome is achieved, stated in the PR body
Tests for each rule, including two concurrent proposals and a withdrawn slice
exclude: Changes to merge gates or to the ticket-creation guard hook beyond the branch it reads
